new_wsa_specific_lessons.lesson: SoundWire slave conversion is bus-driver conversion, not platform macro conversion
new_wsa_specific_lessons.pipeline_rule: Classify bus type before selecting conversion templates.

new_wsa_specific_lessons.lesson: Regmap over SDW is the ownership primitive
new_wsa_specific_lessons.pipeline_rule: Use devm_regmap_init_sdw for SDW slaves, not MMIO or parent regmap patterns.
Infer supply names from downstream DT/binding evidence, not generic vdd/vdd-io guesses.

new_wsa_specific_lessons.lesson: Vendor IRQ wrappers often wrap regmap IRQ semantics
new_wsa_specific_lessons.pipeline_rule: Map wcd_irq wrappers to regmap_irq or SDW interrupt callbacks, not simple deletion.
Classify thermal code as functional, not debug/vendor residue.

cumulative_learning_summary: VA taught governed equivalence and lifecycle split handling for LPASS macros.
TX taught that lessons can improve function/DAPM structure but register/provider inference needs binding evidence.
WSA adds a new architecture class: SoundWire slave codecs with SDW regmap, regulators, SDW IDs, and codec-specific thermal/IRQ flows.
Across three drivers, AURA now needs architecture classifiers before patch planning: platform macro vs SoundWire slave vs amplifier codec.
